notes: While 'مِحْفَظَة' can refer to a briefcase or a file folder, adding 'نُقُود' (money) specifically limits the meaning to a wallet or coin purse.
Often, native speakers will simply refer to it as 'مَحْفَظَة' if the context of shopping is already clear.
